4.8 stars. 98 reviews. At a bakery in Phú Quốc.

Ryrao Bakery at 89 Positano An Thới is quietly racking up one of the best ratings on the island. Fresh bakes, $15-30 a head, and a crowd that clearly keeps coming back.

Not every great spot in Phu Quoc has a beach view. Some just have really good bread.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
